::: {#def-coverage-probability}
#### Coverage probability

The **coverage probability** of an interval $[L, U]$ for a parameter $\param$
is $\Pr(L \le \param \le U)$,
computed over repeated samples with $\param$ held fixed.
A $100(1-\siglevel)\%$ [confidence interval](#def-confidence-interval)
has coverage probability $1 - \siglevel$.
:::
